summary: Preserve keyed message-body reads while checking scoped naming degradation.

replay.detail: Canonical reducers and explicit repair semantics are unchanged.

schema.detail: Reuse the existing primary-keyed meta table for at most 64 derived failure-scope entries.

rules.detail: Naming reads check the keyed health row and exact keyed scope membership instead of scanning the diagnostic JSON array. The message-body query-plan guard remains unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire contract changes; the unreleased scoped projection stores its derived names transactionally alongside the diagnostic row.

manual.detail: Existing planned-window replay guidance is unchanged.

recovery.detail: Scope refresh replaces keyed names transactionally; successful bounded or explicit repair removes them.

downtime.detail: No schema migration or index build is added.
